title: Execute numeric memory records through the OPENMP adapter
problem: OpenMP stdout can succeed while numeric conversion or bounded output counts in accelerator memory are wrong.
example:
omp_is_initial_device() must be false
map(to: input[0:count]) + map(from: output[0:count])
-> format_record on the target -> serialize copied records
design: Require non-initial-device execution, map input encodings to the target and output records from it, then format each record in a target teams distribute parallel for region.
tradeoffs: Runtime execution remains hardware-dependent; source-generation and host record tests validate structure but do not establish accelerator execution.
docs: The memory launcher formats on the selected backend and copies records to the host for byte-exact oracle comparison. Stdout control failure does not hide memory outcomes.
